A variant configuration focusing on the packing options for SH coefficients.

It uses `PackOptions::sh1Bits` (defaulting to `DEFAULT_SH1_BITS`=5) and `PackOptions::shRestBits` (defaulting to `DEFAULT_SH_REST_BITS`=4) to specify quantization bit depths for SH degree 1 and degree 2+ coefficients respectively.
*   **Time Complexity:** Decompression is linear in the number of bytes, dominated by ZSTD decompression and per-Gaussian decoding.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Linear in the number of Gaussians.
It evolved to support higher precision requirements (SmallestThree quaternions) and compression (ZSTD) in later versions.
